n: Sika Foam Backer Rod Open Cell

d.s: Sika Foam Backer Rod Open Cell is manufactured from extruded, open cell polyurethane foam, available in rods with different diameters and lengths.
a: Improved cure rate of sealant due to open cell structure
Compatible with cold applied sealants (polyurethane, silicones)
us: Sika Foam Backer Rod Open Cell is used as a back up material for cold applied Sika sealants to give the sealant the correct thickness. It also acts as a bondbreaker, permitting the most efficient joint design.

sec.t: 5 years if storage condistions are met.
Store in dry conditions and protect from heat.
Good resistance to oil, petrol and solvents.

During installation avoid excessive longitudinal stretching of the rod. For Hot poured sealants consult our Technical Department for heat resistant quality. Do not use as a backer, where sealant is heated and applied at a temperature above +70ºC. Rod diameter should be approximately 25% larger than the joint width.
